'''Baroo''' was the primary city of [[Majan]] people, and was located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]]. It was situated along the coast of the planet's largest continent of the [[Baroo (continent)|same name]]. The ancient city ruins of [[Nazwa]] encircled Baroo on all sides.
